name: Via Lugdunum
description_md:
Via Lugdunum is a hard waymarked hiking route in France spanning 233.7 km. It features 228 m of ascent and 263 m of descent with a walking time of about 5.8 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The route is part of the international waymarked hiking network. Its line matches the official route published by ign_bdtopo. During the journey, the path passes Pérouges within 200 m and Lyon within 1900 m.
